scripts.check: node --check app.js board.js companion-bot.js companion-physics.js content.js perspectives.js recall.js trust.js sw.js && node scripts/export-briefs.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check:trace && npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:prop
scripts.test:companion: cd companion && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -q; else python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q; fi
scripts.gate: npm test && npm run test:companion && npm run test:smoke
scripts.gate:full: npm run gate && npm run test:mutation
